description: Manage DNS zones in a Memset account.

parameters.name: api_key
parameters.description: The API key obtained from the Memset control panel.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Forces deletion of a zone and all zone domains/zone records it contains. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The zone nickname; usually the same as the main domain. Ensure this value has at most 250 characters.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Indicates desired state of resource. Choices: "absent" "present"

parameters.name: ttl
parameters.description: The default TTL for all records created in the zone. This must be a valid int from https://www.memset.com/apidocs/methods_dns.html#dns.zone_create. Choices: 0 ← (default) 300 600 900 1800 3600 7200 10800 21600 43200 86400

examples:
# Create the zone 'test'
- name: Create zone
  community.general.memset_zone:
    name: test
    state: present
    api_key: 5eb86c9196ab03919abcf03857163741
    ttl: 300
  delegate_to: localhost

# Force zone deletion
- name: Force delete zone
  community.general.memset_zone:
    name: test
    state: absent
    api_key: 5eb86c9196ab03919abcf03857163741
    force: true
  delegate_to: localhost

return_values.name: memset_api
return_values.description: Zone info from the Memset API. Returned: when state == present

return_values.name: domains
return_values.description: List of domains in this zone. Returned: always Sample: []

return_values.name: records
return_values.description: List of DNS records for domains in this zone. Returned: always Sample: []

return_values.name: ttl
return_values.description: Default TTL for domains in this zone. Returned: always Sample: 300
